exposure: monoexponential MR imaging parameters (Apparent Diffusion Coefficient (ADC), exponential ADC (eADC))
biexponential MR imaging parameters (pure diffusion coefficient (D), pseudo-diffusion coefficient (D*), perfusion fraction (f))
diffusion kurtosis MR imaging parameters (diffusion kurtosis (MK), mean diffusion coefficient (MD))
outcome: diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders
cohort: The study included 65 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum disorders and 27 patients with normal placentas who underwent specific MRI protocols.
finding: D mean and D max parameters from accreta lesions were significantly different and provided high diagnostic efficiency for differentiating placenta accreta spectrum disorders.
